title: Referenced standards.
officialText:
Where this code makes reference to the nationally recognized standards NFPA 13, NFPA
13D, NFPA 13R, NFPA 14, NFPA 20, or NFPA 72, such standard shall be as modified for New York City in accordance
with Appendix Q.
